description: Can ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity reach and read a website? Score, problems found and fixes.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Check whether AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and more) can reach and read a website: robots.txt rules per agent, firewall blocking, content without JavaScript, structured data. Returns a 0-100 score, the problems found, and how to fix them. The result is also saved as a public report link.
